audiences.executive: Open and run sites without sending IT: standard designs deployed remotely, every site upgraded from one place, and a site that keeps working when a server fails.
audiences.technical: Small clusters from one server to a few, deployed without hands on site, upgraded remotely in waves, with local copies plus replication to the core, encrypted by default, and room for AI at the edge.
audiences.financial: Fewer site visits and emergency replacements; one standard design bought in volume instead of a different one per site.

people: The head of stores, plants or branches
Security, for equipment outside the data centre
Whoever installs equipment at the sites, staff or partner

objections.says: Our sites are too small for this.
objections.clarify: What runs at your smallest site, and what happens when it stops?
objections.answer: One server where a stop can wait, two where it cannot; both managed from the same place as the rest.
objections.prove: Run the smallest site's applications on a one-server test site managed centrally.

objections.says: The links to our sites are too poor.
objections.clarify: Which sites lose their link, and for how long?
objections.answer: Sites keep working alone and catch up when the link returns; upgrades and copies are scheduled around the link.
objections.prove: Cut a test site's link for a working day and show it runs and catches up.

objections.says: We cannot send people to install servers everywhere.
objections.clarify: Who is at the sites today who could plug in a box?
objections.answer: Servers ship configured and join the central plane on their own; nobody with IT skills needs to travel.
objections.prove: Ship a server to a test site and have someone outside IT plug it in.

objections.says: AI at the edge is not for us yet.
objections.clarify: Is there data at the sites, like images or sensor readings, that nobody looks at?
objections.answer: Size the sites so a GPU can be added later; start with the applications that run there today.
objections.prove: Show the site design with room for a GPU, and its cost now and later.
